text:
deploybot: Hold: env parity check failed - keystore.metadata.epoch mismatch (staging: 1692500000, prod: 1692503600). Blocking release.

nina.eng: saw this during preflight. key fingerprints identical; only metadata.epoch differs.

mike.ops: prod backfill ran earlier; staging missed it.

ops-oncall: two choices: 1) controlled metadata sync to staging (fast), 2) pause until nightly parity job (delay ~4h), 3) abort and roll back canary. What do we want in the window?

release-coordinator: prefer a controlled sync with audit. Pin runtime to `inference-runtime@1.11.3` for this rollout. Add a release note entry.

nina.eng: I'll snapshot staging keystore and apply a metadata-only patch from prod. Commands and logs will go to s3://keystore/audit/2938472000/.

mike.ops: patch applied, snapshot saved. audit log: s3://keystore/audit/2938472000/patch.log.

deploybot: Re-running validations... Preflight checks passed. Resuming rollout at canary 5%.

ops-oncall: monitoring rotation jobs for 2h. Update release notes and create follow-up issue to reduce manual fixes.

release-coordinator: noted. marking thread resolved once release notes updated. :white_check_mark:
